caseName: Blatt v. Local Board No. 116, Fredericksburg City Selective Service System
caseNameFull: Blatt v. Local Board No. 116, Fredericksburg City Selective Service System

opinions.text:
C. A. 4th Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Fein v. Selective Service System, ante, p. 365.

Mr. Justice Powell and Mr. Justice Rehnquist took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
